items.docs: Returns a list of compression cycles available to the participant. Cycles represent scheduled multilateral compression runs. Participants can filter by status to see open, in-progress, or completed cycles.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Returns detailed information about a specific compression cycle, including its current status, submission deadlines, participating firms, and schedule.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Returns the list of trades submitted by the participant for a given compression cycle. Used to verify trade submission and review accepted trade population.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Submits or replaces the participant's trade population for a compression cycle. Trade data includes notional, maturity, coupon, and other trade economics required for the compression algorithm. Full access required (not available on read-only API keys).

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Returns the risk data (delta ladders) submitted by the participant for a given compression cycle.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Submits risk constraints (delta ladders, DV01 limits) for a compression cycle. Risk data constrains the optimization algorithm to preserve the participant's aggregate risk profile within specified tolerances.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Returns the compression results for a completed cycle, including the set of terminations and new replacement trades, notional reduction achieved, and summary statistics.

params.name: cycleId
params.description: Unique identifier for the compression cycle

items.docs: Confirms the participant's acceptance of the compression results for a cycle. This is required before terminations and new trades are processed. All participants must confirm before the cycle settles.
